name: 53549 · Jefferson, WI
findings: ZIP 53549 (Jefferson) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53549 (Jefferson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53549 (Jefferson) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).
